external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by a franchise store that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The HR system that supplies changes to group membership and leaver status overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-in, maintains directory membership, signs tokens, and writes sign-ins to the audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The source does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor. Tokens cannot be pulled back before expiry, and leaver changes are pulled once a night.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that lets a holder of a store-manager token change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications. It also runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is supplied by the HR system overnight rather than maintained there by hand. The source does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The source does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: colleague sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: franchise colleague sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague uses the franchise identity provider for sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: identity-provider vouch
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: token issuance
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying a colleague's staff ID and group list.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: Staff ID and group membership token

data_flows.name: application token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a signed token used by the store admin console to decide what the holder may do.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff ID and group membership

data_flows.name: store administration
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console to perform permitted store administration.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.

data_flows.name: public key fetch
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: signing key access
data_flows.description: The identity broker accesses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: overnight group changes
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership changes and leaver status to the identity broker once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: directory maintenance
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleagues and their group membership in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: sign-in audit
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run, and where the broker's stores are located in this model.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home device
trust_boundaries.description: A colleague's own device at home from which the colleague may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise store
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled zone containing franchise colleagues and their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleague identities and group membership.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.
